hero_title: AI Autonomous Mathematics Research Case Study 0001: Riemann Hypothesis Weil Engineering Relay
hero_subtitle: Twenty rounds do not constitute an "AI proof," but rather a replayable, falsifiable research chain that preserves failures and corrections.
status_badge: BATCH 01 COMPLETE — RH NOT PROVED OR DISPROVED

sections.title: What this case study did
sections.body: Starting from the test function kernel, it progressively built real Weil interval matrices, prime-power chambers, mixed-regularity near-zero spectra, parameter tubes, event-surface slicing, a unified certificate backend, and adversarial auditing.

sections.title: Why this is an AI autonomous research case study
sections.body: The AI did not just generate text; it selected research nodes, generated code and certificates, discovered false negatives and missing terms, corrected previous rounds, retained failures, and formed the next batch of structured handoffs for continuation.

sections.title: What it did not do
sections.body: It did not prove or disprove RH; it did not pass off finite-dimensional positivity as global positivity; it did not treat floating-point negative values as counterexamples; it did not pass off internal hashes as external authenticity.
